=== SKILL: add-regression-tests ===
---
name: add-regression-tests
description: When modifying existing code logic or fixing bugs, ensure new tests are added to verify the change and prevent future regressions before marking the task as complete.
---
- Identify the specific behavior or bug being addressed by the code change.
- Write a test case that fails without the fix and passes with it.
- Integrate the new test into the existing test suite.
- Run the full test suite to confirm no other tests are broken.
- Verify that the new test is included in the final commit or submission.
=== END ===
